design.design_origin: After the 2026-10-29 review and prior analyses; not preregistered
design.primary_cohort: 805 actually masked all/warm90 common crossed-forward archives; 468 nontrivial-choice subset
design.denominator_sensitivity: 807 original common archives restores two zero-mask cases; 13 warm90-unavailable cases remain outside paired comparisons
design.enumeration: Enumerate every same-count subset of incomplete years, retaining all fixed complete years
design.uniform_reference: Equal probability for each feasible subset within each archive; average squared errors within archive before cross-archive RMSE
design.cdf_objective: Minimize mean squared difference of retained and full-year empirical CDFs over integer calendar years min(full)..max(full), including fixed complete years
design.sxx_objective: Maximize centered Sxx in decade units over retained fixed complete plus selected incomplete years
design.tie_break: CDF: minimum CDF, maximum Sxx, lexicographically earliest incomplete-year tuple; Sxx: maximum Sxx, minimum CDF, earliest tuple. Objective ties rounded at 14 decimals.
design.selection_forbidden: Truth H30, reconstructed H30, errors, hot-year flags and source outcomes never enter either objective
design.random_seed_rule: SeedSequence([969, archive_replicate, draw_seed, four little-endian SHA256 station words]); uniform integer into lexicographic feasible subsets

bootstrap.unit: connected group; all paired archive rows retained

design.random_variation: Across-seed percentiles are conditional selection variation, not confidence intervals; report mean(RMSE) separately from sqrt(mean(MSE))
design.gap_units: Annual longest contiguous missing run; observed station-year vs trial station-year-replicate. Trial runs use zero-based start indices.
design.daily_overlap_denominator: Only incomplete station-years and missing station-days with at least one other evaluable same-group station in that year. Single-station group-years are excluded, with counts reported.
limits: No model refit, new station, new data download or causal identification
Same-count controls still cannot separately identify year count and position effects
Group bootstrap describes this cohort and assumes exchangeability of the recorded clusters
Same-day co-missingness does not establish common failure cause, donor use or an unobserved physical outage
